articles.title: College Football Teams Experience Unpredictable Week 9 Schedule
articles.summary: The Week 9 college football schedule saw several top-ranked teams experience setbacks against unranked opponents, with five teams dropping in rankings after two windows of play.
articles.content: The Week 9 college football schedule was marked by unexpected twists and turns, with several AP Top 25 teams experiencing setbacks against unranked opponents. A total of five top-ranked teams dropped in rankings following the first two windows of play. The losses included three instances where ranked teams fell to unseeded opponents, a testament to the unpredictability of college football. Meanwhile, some powerhouses continued to assert their dominance on the field. No. 3 Georgia made short work of rival Florida, while No. 13 Texas Tech finally looked like a legitimate contender in the Big 12 conference. In another closely contested matchup, No. 4 Indiana found itself facing a seemingly insurmountable deficit after Minnesota scored a 60-yard field goal with just seconds remaining in regulation. It appeared as though the Hoosiers had squandered their chances of victory. Despite being down to their last breaths, Indiana managed to conjure up a miraculous comeback, tying the game and eventually emerging victorious in overtime with a nail-biting field goal. The momentum gained by Wisconsin after its impressive start to the season has come to an abrupt halt. The Badgers' loss to Iowa was a crushing blow, one that will likely leave fans reeling and wondering what went wrong. On the field, it was clear that Wisconsin was outmatched in every aspect of the game. Despite their best efforts, they were unable to muster any semblance of offense, managing a paltry 52 yards rushing. Meanwhile, Iowa's quarterback Hank Brown had a standout performance, completing an impressive 20-of-24 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns. The loss has sent shockwaves through the Wisconsin faithful, who had been riding high on the team's earlier successes under coach Luke Fickell. The Badgers' chances of reaching their expected level of success have taken a major hit, and it remains to be seen how they will bounce back from this setback. In contrast, Texas Tech's season was thought to be all but over after a disappointing loss to Cincinnati last week. However, coach Joey McGuire chose to stick with backup quarterback Thomas Castellanos, and the move has proved to be a masterstroke. Oregon's fortunes have taken a dramatic turn since Dylan Raiola was thrust into the starting lineup in place of Dante Moore. The young quarterback's performance against No. 20 Northwestern was marked by early adversity, as the Ducks found themselves down 10-0. However, Raiola defied expectations and produced one of his best games yet. He completed an impressive 22-of-31 passes for a total of 336 yards and three touchdowns. The Nebraska transfer's resurgence is largely attributed to the efforts of new offensive coordinator Jay Johnson, who allowed Oregon's talented receivers to make their mark in space. The Ducks' chances of making the playoffs remain slim, but they will face a significant test next week when they travel to No. 2 Ohio State. This high-stakes matchup provides Raiola with an opportunity to solidify his reputation and prove himself as a top prospect. Meanwhile, Oklahoma's struggles continue under coach Brent Venables, who is on the verge of his third losing season in five years. The Sooners suffered a humiliating 42-25 defeat at home against South Carolina, a loss that may signal the end for offensive coordinator Ben Arbuckle. The Sooners' struggles continued under head coach Brent Venables as they suffered another dismal performance on the field. In stark contrast to Oklahoma's woes, DJ Lagway of Baylor University had a standout game against UCF, completing 64% of his passes and throwing for four touchdowns without an interception. His impressive display earned him significant praise despite the circumstances surrounding his team's coaching change. Baylor's victory over UCF was marked by a renewed sense of urgency that has been lacking in the team throughout the season. The Bears' performance against one of the Big 12's stingiest defenses served as a testament to their potential when they play with conviction. Meanwhile, SMU's hopes for a College Football Playoff spot took a hit after a heartbreaking loss to Syracuse. Despite being ranked No. 19 and having only one close loss on their record, the Mustangs' inability to capitalize on opportunities has become a recurring theme in recent years. The 30-27 defeat at the hands of Syracuse was particularly frustrating for SMU, coming as it did against a team that had struggled to find consistency this season. The Mustangs have been agonizingly close to returning to the College Football Playoff, including a last-play loss to California earlier in the year. The Hornets' inaugural transition to FBS has been a challenging one, marked by seven consecutive losses. However, their fortunes changed against Kent State, where they secured their first-ever FBS victory with a convincing 31-10 win. In the game, running back Isaiah Ene made a significant impact, rushing for 107 yards and scoring two touchdowns. This much-needed success could provide the Hornets with crucial momentum as they head into the final stretch of the season. articles.title: Wicker Premieres with Mixed Reactions from Viewers
articles.summary: The unconventional new film Wicker has left audiences with a range of emotions after its premiere this weekend.
articles.content: The unconventional new film Wicker has left viewers with a mix of emotions and reactions after its premiere this weekend. The movie, directed by Alex Huston Fischer and Eleanor Wilson, stars Olivia Colman alongside Alexander Skarsgård, Peter Dinklage, and Elizabeth Debicki. Some initial confusion arose when the title card for Black Bear's production company was mistaken for the opening scene of the film. This was quickly followed by a range of reactions to the movie's unique content. One observer couldn't help but feel a strong distaste upon witnessing Olivia Colman making love to a wicker figure in the shape of a man. The surreal and often humorous moments in Wicker have sparked a diverse array of thoughts and feelings among viewers. For some, the film's unusual premise has generated excitement, particularly when Olivia Colman appears on screen wearing a wicker backpack. The presence of Peter Dinklage also drew enthusiastic reactions from audiences. As the movie progresses, it becomes clear that Wicker is not just about its eccentric characters or settings, but also about exploring themes and ideas through unconventional storytelling methods. The film's use of unconventional storytelling methods is particularly evident in its portrayal of themes and ideas through eccentric characters and settings. Wicker's narrative explores complex questions about relationships and identity, often blurring the lines between reality and fantasy. A key aspect of this exploration is the way the movie subverts traditional expectations around masculinity and relationships. The film's depiction of a romantic partnership between two men challenges societal norms and raises questions about what it means to be a "perfect being". This theme is particularly relevant in today's dating landscape, where people are increasingly questioning traditional notions of love and relationships. The film also explores the idea of identity and self-expression through its characters' personalities and quirks. The actress playing Olivia shines in her scene-stealing moments, bringing a sense of joy and playfulness to the role. Her character's antics often leave viewers laughing and questioning their own values and morals. The use of wicker as a metaphor for relationships is another clever device employed by the film. The character made entirely of wicker raises questions about what it means to be whole and complete, particularly in the context of romantic partnerships. This theme is further complicated by the character's ability to fix things, adding a layer of complexity to the narrative that keeps viewers engaged and invested. The intricate world of 'Wicker' continues to captivate audiences with its offbeat charm and quirky humor. articles.title: 3D Printing Technology Becomes Prevalent in Various Industries and Applications
articles.summary: The use of 3D printing technology has become increasingly prevalent in various industries and applications, from creating tools on demand for astronauts on the International Space Station to producing replacement parts.
articles.content: The use of 3D printing technology has become increasingly prevalent in various industries and applications, from creating tools on demand for astronauts on the International Space Station to producing replacement parts. On Earth, enthusiasts have discovered that owning a 3D printer can be a cost-effective way to create components and accessories for their hobbies. While entry-level 3D printers like the Creality Ender-3 V3 SE are available for around $170, more advanced systems can reach prices of over $700. The cost of materials also plays a significant role in determining the overall expense of 3D printing. Filament is the most common material used by these machines and costs approximately $20 per kilogram. If you plan to use your 3D printer frequently, it's essential to calculate the total cost of materials and hardware to determine where you can save money. To put this into perspective, if you create 50 items that each cost $10 using a kilogram of filament on a $170 machine, owning a 3D printer may be a more affordable option. In addition to purchasing your own printer, some libraries and maker spaces offer access to these machines for the public. Online services also provide printing options at a set price per item. This flexibility can make it unnecessary to buy your own 3D printer if you only need occasional use. The type of 3D printer used also affects its cost-effectiveness. Most home printers rely on FDM (fused deposition modeling) technology, which involves pushing heated plastic filament through a nozzle to create objects. This method is often less expensive than using resin or polymer powder in more advanced 3D printers. In the following sections, we will explore specific hobbies where owning a 3D printer can save you money by reducing the cost of components and accessories. These examples focus on FDM printers, but it's worth noting that SLA printers may be necessary for applications requiring fine detail. Drone enthusiasts can benefit from owning a 3D printer as it allows them to print spare parts at a lower cost than buying them online. Many 3D modeling sites have dedicated sections for drone components, which indicates the popularity of this practice. However, it's crucial to note that printing flight-critical pieces should only be done after thorough validation of material, design, and strength. Other drone parts such as camera mounts, antenna guards, and arm protectors can be printed with ease using a 3D printer. These components often require frequent replacement due to crashes or wear and tear, making it cost-effective in the long run. For instance, if a part normally costs $10, printing it at home can save money over time. In addition to drone enthusiasts, individuals who work with vehicles or maintain gardens also find their 3D printer to be an invaluable resource. Mechanic or gardener alike often go through numerous replaceable components that may be cheaper to print than buy in bulk or from specialty stores. This is particularly true for parts that are sold in larger quantities than needed. The versatility of a 3D printer extends beyond vehicle and garden maintenance, with many useful items available for printing. Garden signage, plastic clips, planters, soil dibbers, and even bird feeders can be created at home using this technology. In the garage, one can print hard-to-find car interior pieces, broken knobs, tool organizers, wrenches, and a multi-axis vise. The convenience of printing specific tools on demand can save time, money, and frustration in any garden or garage setting. With access to a 3D printer, individuals can create exactly what they need when they need it, eliminating the need for costly replacements or specialty purchases. The versatility of 3D printers extends beyond crafting personal items to also encompass home automation solutions. With this technology, individuals can create customized tools and components for their smart homes. This includes designing and printing cable management systems, shelving units, wall mounts, and spare parts tailored to specific needs. Moreover, the potential for creative expression in home automation projects is vast. For instance, users can print housings or button mechanisms for NFC stickers that control various devices around the house. These components can be designed to be visually appealing, adding a personal touch to smart home installations. The ability to create custom parts also applies to other areas of home design. Individuals can print a Tap-for-Wi-Fi sign that uses NFC technology to provide guest access, or even design and build a desktop robot for added functionality. For those who prefer a more integrated approach, 3D printing allows users to create a Home Assistant touch screen chassis at a significantly lower cost than proprietary alternatives. The impact of 3D printing on home automation is not limited to aesthetics; it also addresses practical concerns. In the realm of photography and videography, camera manufacturers often charge high prices for replaceable items like lens caps and cable clamps. However, with access to 3D printing files, users can create universal lens caps at a fraction of the cost. Photography enthusiasts can take advantage of numerous online resources offering 3D printing designs for various camera accessories, including battery holders and other frequently replaced components. By leveraging these digital blueprints, individuals can save money on unnecessary purchases and focus on more creative aspects of their photography practice. Owning a 3D printer can be particularly beneficial for those involved in tabletop gaming and scale modeling hobbies. With a 3D printer, individuals can create custom models, terrain pieces, or characters that perfectly fit their specific needs. In the world of tabletop gaming, players can use 3D printing to create historically accurate miniature figures, allowing them to immerse themselves even further in the game. Additionally, gamers with a penchant for fantasy worlds can print buildings, trees, and other environmental features to enhance their gameplay experience. The versatility of 3D printing extends beyond gaming as well. Model railroad enthusiasts can use these machines to print custom tracks, bridges, or scenery pieces that add depth and realism to their layouts. Moreover, the technology enables users to create intricate details such as logos or other small components with ease. One of the most significant advantages of using a 3D printer is its ability to produce single-use tools for specific tasks. This can be particularly useful in photography when trying to capture a particular shot, owners can print custom camera mounts, tripods, or even selfie handles to achieve the desired result. Ultimately, investing in a 3D printer requires careful consideration of one's needs and abilities. However, by weighing these factors and exploring the capabilities of this technology, hobbyists may find that it becomes an indispensable tool in their creative pursuits. articles.content: Amazon has quietly disabled voice control for the auxiliary (AUX) input on several older Echo speakers. This move affects devices such as the second-generation Echo Plus and third-generation Echo, among others, making it less convenient to switch to a wired audio source. The affected models include the original Echo Studio and fourth-generation Echo, all of which were released in recent years. Amazon's decision has been confirmed, but the company hasn't provided an explanation for why this feature was removed. The change may seem minor, but it can be frustrating for users who rely on voice commands to switch between different audio sources. The removal of voice control for AUX input does not affect the physical connection itself. Owners can still connect their devices using a cable and use the Alexa app to enable or disable AUX input. However, this requires more effort and may not provide the same level of convenience as voice commands. Amazon has notified customers who rely on voice requests for AUX playback, but it's unclear how many people are affected by this change. The company has not disclosed any plans to reinstate the feature or provide an alternative solution. The AUX input feature on older Alexa devices has been compromised in some way, making it less useful for users who rely on this functionality. Some Echo speakers, including the third-generation Echo and fourth-generation Echo, have a 3.5mm AUX jack that can serve as both an input and output connection. However, when used as an output, this feature now appears to be non-functional, preventing Alexa's audio from being sent to another speaker or amplifier via a wired connection. Users who want to play external audio through their Echo speakers are still able to do so, but the process may require some adjustments in the Alexa app settings. Depending on the device model and app version, users can enable "Line In" to play audio from an external source, such as a phone or computer. The AUX input feature is not entirely eliminated, but its functionality has been limited in some way. This change affects Echo speakers that support both input and output connections, including the second-generation Echo Plus. Older Echo devices, like the original Echo Studio, still have a 3.5mm connection that can be used to play audio from external sources, but it is unclear if this feature will continue to work as intended in the future. When using an older Alexa device's AUX input, users must control playback through the connected equipment's own controls, rather than relying on voice commands that are no longer supported. The AUX feature remains functional in older Echo devices, but upgrading to newer models with a 3.5mm input may mean sacrificing this functionality, as seen in the transition from the first-generation Echo Studio to its redesigned counterpart. articles.content: Georgia's dominance over Florida in their recent matchup may have been a convincing one, but it was not without its flaws. The Bulldogs' offense struggled to find consistency throughout the game, managing only 318 yards of total offense against a Florida defense that has had its share of troubles this season. However, Georgia's defense more than made up for the lackluster performance on offense by forcing four turnovers, which proved crucial in the team's 27-8 victory. The Bulldogs' ability to capitalize on these mistakes helped them build a significant lead and ultimately secure the win. Despite the convincing scoreline, concerns about Georgia's passing game are beginning to emerge. Quarterback Gunner Stockton struggled to make an impact against Florida's porous secondary, which has been one of the weaker units in the conference. Entering this matchup, Florida ranked poorly in several key passing defense categories, including 13th in the SEC and 121st nationally in passing yards allowed per game, with an EPA (Expected Points Added) per dropback rating of just 0.23 and a passing success rate of 50.7%. Georgia's passing game was held back by its quarterback, Stetson Stockton, who completed just 13 of his 23 pass attempts for a total of 101 yards in the recent matchup against Florida. Despite having some bright spots, including freshman receiver Craig Dandridge who led the team with 39 receiving yards, the Bulldogs struggled to find their rhythm through the air. Much of Dandridge's production came from a single long play that accounted for over three-quarters of his total yardage. Kirby Smart, Georgia's head coach, acknowledged that his team had missed some crucial throws and left points on the field during the game against Florida. He expressed a desire to see improvement in this area before the next challenge. Georgia faces a tough schedule ahead, with upcoming games against Ole Miss, Missouri, and South Carolina, all of which feature quarterbacks who have shown an ability to put up significant numbers against top defenses. Georgia's offense has shown flashes of brilliance this season, but lingering concerns about its passing game threaten to undermine their championship aspirations. In recent games, Bulldogs quarterback Stetson Stockton has demonstrated his ability to make big plays, throwing for 295 yards and three touchdowns against Vanderbilt and delivering several difficult completions in the road win over Alabama. However, his performance against Florida raised some red flags. Stockton's inconsistency is a major concern, as he has shown a tendency to make mistakes even when he's producing well. His three turnovers against Auburn were a significant factor in the Tigers' victory, highlighting the need for him to be more efficient and reliable. Georgia's receiving corps lacks a consistent playmaker, with Dandrige leading the team with 20 receptions for 349 yards. The Bulldogs have a strong group of tight ends, but none of them have emerged as a significant threat in the passing game on a regular basis, with Lawson Luckie being the most notable exception, hauling in 12 catches for 197 yards and two touchdowns. Georgia may have managed to escape Florida with their win, but there are still concerns about their passing game that could impact their chances of securing a national championship. The team's defense has proven itself capable of containing talented quarterbacks, as seen in their performance against Keelon Russell. However, this might not be enough to guarantee success against the top offenses they will face in the playoffs, including those from Miami, Notre Dame, and LSU, which have all shown the ability to put up high scores. Georgia's ultimate goal is a national championship, and they will likely encounter potent offenses along the way, with Ohio State boasting the country's best player, Jeremiah Smith, who consistently puts up impressive numbers. articles.title: SpaceX's Starship Rocket Surpasses Conventional Wisdom in Size and Power
articles.summary: The current configuration of SpaceX's Starship launch vehicle stands at an impressive 407 feet tall, surpassing the tallest living tree, Hyperion, and exceeding the Statue of Liberty's pedestal.
articles.content: SpaceX's Starship rocket has made significant strides in space exploration, defying conventional wisdom that bigger is not always better. The current configuration of the Starship launch vehicle stands at an impressive 407 feet tall when both stages are stacked together. This towering height surpasses even the tallest living tree, Hyperion, and exceeds the Statue of Liberty's pedestal included by a significant margin. The sheer scale of this rocket makes it the tallest ever flown, with an unfurled might that also earns it the title of most powerful. Its liftoff thrust is an astonishing 18.1 million pounds-force. The imposing dimensions of Starship serve a specific purpose: to transport massive payloads into space and eventually facilitate human settlements beyond Earth's orbit. The rocket's vast size allows for the carriage of significant cargo, marking a crucial step in the development of long-distance space travel. To achieve this ambitious goal, SpaceX has designed the system with reusability in mind. Both stages are intended to be recovered after launch. The Super Heavy booster forms the base of the Starship configuration and provides the initial boost from the launchpad. This 236.2-foot section is followed by the 170.6-foot Starship spacecraft, which will eventually carry both people and cargo into space. The success of this project can be seen in the aftermath of its first full-stack launch in April 2023, where the booster's exhaust caused significant damage to the concrete pad, scattering debris across a wide area. The sheer scale of SpaceX's Starship rocket is staggering, thanks in part to the massive Super Heavy booster that powers it. With 33 Raptor engines burning liquid methane and oxygen, this behemoth generates a whopping 18.1 million pounds-force of thrust at liftoff. To put that into perspective, NASA's Space Launch System produces significantly less thrust, ranging from 8.8 to 9.4 million pounds-force. However, the Super Heavy booster is only one part of the equation - once it separates, Starship itself will continue on its journey with a more modest propulsion system. The rocket's immense power is matched by its capacity for carrying heavy payloads. With a listed propellant capacity of 3,650 metric tons in the Super Heavy booster and an additional 1,600 metric tons in Starship, this combination can lift a total of 5,250 metric tons into space. Despite its incredible capabilities, even Starship will require refueling in Earth orbit for NASA's planned lunar-landing missions. The SpaceX lunar lander will burn through a significant portion of its propellant just to reach orbit, necessitating a mid-course refueling stop. The SpaceX lunar lander will be prepositioned in Earth orbit, where it will meet with NASA's Orion spacecraft carrying two crew members. To reach this point, a propellant depot will launch first, followed by tanker Starships that deliver fuel to the depot. Once the depot is fully stocked, the lunar lander can dock and take on the necessary propellants for its mission to the Moon's surface. This process involves several complex stages, including refueling and a support system designed to handle extremely cold propellants in space. The prepositioned Starship lander will then carry two crew members to the Moon's surface and back, marking a significant milestone in the Artemis program and the broader effort to return humans to the lunar surface. articles.title: Microbats Studied through Citizen Science Project in Western Australia
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a novel approach to studying microbats using citizen science in Western Australia.
articles.content: A novel approach to studying microbats has been developed by a team of researchers who have turned to citizen science to help fill in the knowledge gaps surrounding these fascinating creatures. Microbats are notoriously difficult to find and study due to their nocturnal habits, small size, and fast flight, making them a challenging subject for scientists. To overcome this obstacle, researchers recruited a handful of volunteers from Western Australia to participate in a citizen science project. The volunteers were equipped with bat detectors that convert the ultrasonic calls of microbats into sound recordings that humans can hear. These devices also help identify which bats are present by capturing the distinct frequencies and patterns of each species' calls. Bats are incredibly diverse, with over 80 different species found in Australia alone, ranging from the tiny little forest bat to the larger gray-headed flying fox. Globally, they make up around 22% of all mammal species, except for those that inhabit Antarctica. The project's focus on citizen science aims not only to gather valuable data about microbats but also to engage the public and encourage a deeper understanding of these animals and their importance in ecosystems. Bats can be broadly categorized into two groups: microbats and megabats. Although these terms are not formal scientific classifications, they are commonly used to distinguish smaller bats from their larger counterparts. In Australia, microbats tend to feed on insects, while megabats, such as flying foxes, primarily consume fruit, nectar, and pollen. The unique characteristics of bats make them fascinating creatures. As the only mammals capable of true flight, they flap their wings actively rather than relying on gliding or falling. Bats also play a crucial role in maintaining ecosystem balance. For instance, flying foxes contribute to pollination and seed dispersal for native plants, while insect-eating microbats help regulate insect populations. Despite their importance, bats often go unnoticed by the general public. Their nocturnal behavior means that people rarely encounter them up close. Additionally, misconceptions and negative perceptions about bats persist in society. Researchers face challenges when studying bats due to their nocturnal habits and tendency to roost during the day in hard-to-access locations such as tree hollows and caves. To locate these elusive creatures, scientists often rely on specialized equipment like ultrasonic bat detectors. Our research team analyzed 51 published studies on bat citizen science projects from around the world and found that acoustic surveys were the most common approach used to locate these elusive creatures. Acoustic surveys involve using ultrasonic detectors to record bats as they fly past, but few studies have investigated what participants gain from being involved in such projects. This lack of focus led our team to conduct its own study on the benefits of citizen science for bat research and conservation. In 2025, we invited residents of Perth's City of Wanneroo to participate in a bat-finding mission, recruiting volunteers through social media and local environmental networks. We trained participants to use bat detectors connected to smartphones and taught them about the local bat species that inhabit the area. Our volunteers conducted surveys along set routes through bushland near their homes, listening for and recording bats as they flew by. Over the course of 23 surveys, our team collected data on five different bat species, with Gould's wattled bat being the most commonly detected species. The study's findings have shed light on which bat species are present in Perth's urban areas, raising questions about why some bats are better adapted to living among humans than others. To gain a deeper understanding of people's perspectives on bats, researchers conducted in-person surveys with participants three times: before they began collecting data, immediately after completing the training session, and following their own survey efforts. These questionnaires probed participants' knowledge of bats, their attitudes towards these animals, and how connected they felt to nature. The results showed that participants gained a greater understanding of bats and developed a stronger sense of connection with the natural world through their involvement in the research project. Moreover, researchers observed positive changes in how participants viewed bats, indicating a shift from fear or indifference to appreciation. Some participants reported overcoming initial fears or lack of exposure to bats by conducting their own surveys, while others enjoyed the opportunity to safely observe nocturnal wildlife in its natural habitat at night, highlighting the educational and experiential value of citizen science projects. The experience of participating in bat surveys has been transformative for many individuals, allowing them to overcome initial fears or lack of exposure to these nocturnal creatures. Some participants discovered that conducting their own surveys not only helped them develop a newfound appreciation for bats but also provided an opportunity to safely observe wildlife in its natural habitat at night. This hands-on experience often sparked a sense of wonder and curiosity about the natural world, motivating individuals to learn more about the species they encountered. In some cases, participants even reported developing a deeper understanding of the importance of conservation efforts. Ultimately, citizen science projects like bat surveys offer a unique opportunity for people to contribute to scientific research while also fostering a greater appreciation for the natural world and its inhabitants. By participating in these initiatives, individuals can play an active role in advancing our understanding of nocturnal animals and promoting their conservation. articles.title: Mexican boxer Jaime Munguia successfully defended his WBA super middleweight title
articles.summary: Munguia defeated Nikita Zon at the Kingdom Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, in a highly entertaining but often chaotic bout.
articles.content: Mexican boxer Jaime Munguia successfully defended his WBA super middleweight title in a highly entertaining but often chaotic bout against Nikita Zon at the Kingdom Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Munguia, who has been training under renowned coach Eddy Reynoso, faced an unorthodox opponent in Zon, a Russian boxer known for his rough and aggressive fighting style. The fight was marked by numerous rounds of intense brawling, with both fighters engaging in unrestrained exchanges that left little room for technical finesse. Munguia's performance in the ring was a departure from what one might expect from a fighter under Reynoso's guidance, who are often known for their technical skill and precision. Instead, Munguia relied on his rugged and heavy-handed approach to combat Zon's relentless pressure. Zon came out swinging in the opening round, landing two late punches after a break that left Munguia momentarily stunned. Munguia struggled to find his footing in the second round, as Zon continued to push him back with a series of precise jabs and hooks. The Mexican was left stumbling, trying to regain his balance after being caught off guard by Zon's unorthodox attacks. Zon's southpaw stance allowed him to exploit Munguia's tendency to lean in, making it difficult for the WBA champion to land clean shots. Despite this, Munguia managed to find some success with a few well-placed left hooks that landed on Zon's exposed ribs. Munguia capitalized on Zon's awkward posture in the third round, landing a straight shot that sent him stumbling back against the ropes. The Mexican seized the opportunity to unleash a flurry of punches, but Zon managed to weather the storm and continue his relentless pressure. As the fight wore on, Munguia began to find more success by targeting the holes in Zon's defense, including his exposed chin and vulnerable right hand. By the fifth round, Munguia was making Zon pay for his defensive lapses, landing a massive shot that sent him stumbling back against the ropes. The momentum shifted dramatically in favor of Nikita Zon as he landed a devastating counter left uppercut that sent Jaime Munguia stumbling back against the ropes. This was the round of the night, with both fighters exchanging power punches in frenetic fashion, but it was Zon who had his moment, hurting the champion with a series of precision shots. Referee Tony Weeks even appeared ready to intervene at one stage, such was the danger Munguia found himself in, but he managed to survive against all odds. Zon's aggressive approach ultimately proved to be his downfall as he began to tire and lose control, allowing Munguia to regain his composure and take advantage of his opponent's decline. As the round wore on, Zon struggled to conserve his energy, a concern given that he had never boxed beyond the eighth round in his career. As the judges' scorecards were tallied, Jaime Munguia emerged victorious in a unanimous decision win, securing his WBA title with scores of 116-112 and 117-111 (twice). In a post-fight interview, Munguia reflected on the challenging bout, stating that it was "a little complicated" but ultimately successful. He praised his own resilience, crediting himself for adapting to the unexpected twists in the fight. Munguia acknowledged that he faced setbacks during the sixth round, where Nikita Zon managed to catch him off guard twice. Despite this, Munguia remained composed and continued to push forward, ultimately securing a hard-fought win to advance his record to 47-2, 35 KOs. This regular-season Division I game will take place at Palazzetto dello Sport in Rome, Italy, which has been hosting basketball events since the 1950s. articles.title: Protests Against Living Costs Sweep Across France
articles.summary: Mass protests against living costs and strained public services swept across France on Saturday with an estimated 320,000 people participating.
articles.content: Mass protests against living costs and strained public services swept across France on Saturday, with an estimated 320,000 people participating in demonstrations nationwide, according to the interior ministry. Organizers claim nearly half a million protesters took part. The protests were largely peaceful throughout the afternoon, but tensions flared up at the end of marches in some cities. Scuffles broke out in Paris and other French cities as protesters continued their drive against what they see as unbearable living costs and strained public services. The demonstrations are now into their third weekend after a wave of riots and looting on October 17 left a trail of damage to shops, public buildings, and businesses across the country. The authorities were caught off guard by the scale of the violence that erupted back then. Riot police charged small groups of rioters at the end of the Paris march, while tear gas was fired in Lyon and Toulouse. There were also tensions at unauthorised protests in Marseille before calm eventually returned as night fell. The interior minister has praised security forces for maintaining public order despite facing a great deal of violence. Minister Laurent Nuñez is now warning that authorities are bracing themselves for scattered unrest later in the evening, amid calls for insurrection on Halloween night. As the protests continue to unfold across France, authorities are preparing for potential clashes later in the evening. Minister Laurent Nuñez has issued a warning that authorities will respond firmly if anyone attempts to stir up trouble tonight. The demonstrations have inspired similar movements across Europe, with youth-led protests taking place in several German cities on Saturday and also in Italy. The marches in France brought together students who had been mobilizing since September with trade unions and smaller groups of anti-establishment Yellow Vest protesters. All these disparate groups are united by their frustration over the cost of living, high fuel prices, rising inflation, and President Emmanuel Macron's government. Their concerns were echoed by Jerome Rodriguez, a protester in Paris, who said that families are struggling to make ends meet while politicians juggle billions of euros. Far-left leader Jean-Luc Mélenchon was among those marching through the streets of Paris, his ratings having risen in recent weeks ahead of next April's presidential election. The route taken by protesters had been altered at the last minute due to a court decision that upheld a ban on a march between two key Paris squares. The number of protesters nationwide has decreased from previous weeks, according to the interior ministry, with an estimated 320,000 people taking part in demonstrations across France on Saturday. This is lower than the 410,000 recorded the week before and 550,000 on October 17. Organizer estimates put the turnout at nearly half a million. The interior ministry reported that attempts were made by "radical elements" to break away from marches in several cities, including Bordeaux, Toulouse, Lyon, and Marseille, with the intention of causing damage and looting. However, these individuals were thwarted by security forces who maintained control over the situation. Security checks at railway stations and roads revealed people carrying objects that could be used as weapons, which further highlights the potential for violence. Authorities have expressed concern that Halloween masks may be utilized to conceal the identities of rioters, making it more challenging to identify those responsible. The government is facing increased pressure due to its financial situation, with ratings agency Fitch revising its outlook on French debt to negative on Friday. This decision underscores investor concerns over France's finances, as public debt approaches 120 percent of economic output and borrowing costs rise. Protesters have been advised to exercise caution by the US Embassy due to ongoing demonstrations across France. The protests gained momentum in late September as discussions began on the 2027 budget for Macron's minority government. This development has led to a surge in participation from students, who are unhappy with the state of schools and overcrowded classrooms, as well as trade unions and the revived Yellow Vests movement, which is demanding action on living costs. Despite promises by the French government to reform education and reduce fuel costs, discontent among protesters remains. Many young people feel that their future is at stake due to a lack of resources. Aaron Berthier de Grandry, a 15-year-old high school student from Nogent-sur-Marne, expressed his concerns about France's future. He believes that if the country's youth lacks essential resources, it will ultimately collapse. The ongoing unrest has handed Marine Le Pen, leader of the far-right party, a significant political advantage ahead of the April presidential election. Her potential centrist opponents are currently divided and struggling to gain ground. articles.content: A federal judge has dismissed President Donald Trump's $10 billion defamation suit against an unidentified media outlet in Florida, ruling that the lawsuit lacks merit and is the second attempt to bring the case. The lawsuit centers around a story published last July about a birthday card allegedly sent by Trump to Jeffrey Epstein in 2003. The card was part of a book assembled by Ghislaine Maxwell for Epstein's 50th birthday. Trump had claimed friendship with Epstein during that time, but the judge found his allegations against the media outlet unconvincing, stating that Trump failed to demonstrate actual malice on the part of the defendants in making defamatory statements. A key aspect of Trump's defamation suit was his claim that a birthday card featuring a hand-drawn naked woman and his name in the pubic area was fabricated by the media outlet. However, evidence suggests otherwise. The card included a typewritten note depicting an imaginary conversation with Epstein, who would later face charges related to sex trafficking. The authenticity of the card has been corroborated by Epstein's estate, which released a copy matching the description provided by the paper. This move has further complicated Trump's claims that no such note existed and that the document was entirely fabricated. The discrepancy raises questions about the validity of his defamation suit. Trump and the White House continue to maintain that the card is a fake. However, this stance contradicts their own earlier statements, as they have previously criticized the paper for not publishing an image of the card in the initial story, implying that its existence was verifiable. The Journal has argued that Trump's claim of defamation hinges on the idea that he never wrote the birthday card to Epstein, but their own investigation and reporting contradict this assertion. A closer examination of the original story reveals that the paper did indeed investigate the matter, as evidenced by a letter written to Maxwell's attorney requesting an interview. The Journal also made it clear in their article that Trump had denied writing the card, labeling it a fake. Furthermore, the attorneys for the Journal have pointed out that simply sending a birthday card to someone is not defamatory in nature, and therefore cannot be considered grounds for a defamation lawsuit. A judge has dismissed a defamation lawsuit brought by former President Donald Trump against an outlet over its reporting of a birthday card allegedly signed by him for convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. The dismissal is the latest development in a case that centers on a disputed signature on a birthday book page created by Ghislaine Maxwell, who was implicated in Epstein's crimes. The White House has maintained that the signature is not Trump's, citing its distinctiveness compared to his usual full signature. articles.title: AI Chatbots Fail to Replace Human Connection Despite User Preferences
articles.summary: A recent study published in Communications Psychology revealed a paradoxical trend where users prefer human connection over AI-generated empathy.
articles.content: As people increasingly turn to artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots for companionship and emotional support, researchers are exploring whether AI-generated empathy can replace human connection. A recent study published in Communications Psychology has shed light on this question, revealing a paradoxical trend where users rate AI-generated empathetic responses higher than those from humans, yet still prefer human empathy. The study, led by researchers at Penn State, involved examining people's actual choices and preferences when interacting with AI-powered chatbots. According to the researchers, this approach allowed them to uncover what people truly value in terms of emotional support. Interestingly, despite rating AI-generated responses as more empathetic, participants consistently opted for human connection over AI. C. Daryl Cameron, a leading researcher on the project, notes that their study aimed to understand people's actual preferences by observing their choices in real-time. This approach revealed a complex dynamic where users appear to value the content of AI-generated responses, finding them to be empathetic and validating, but still prefer human interaction. The researchers observed that while there is a subset of the population interested in AI empathy, many others reject it despite rating its quality higher than human-generated responses. Cameron suggests that this paradox highlights the importance of understanding people's preferences through their actual choices, rather than relying on self-reported opinions or ratings. This study contributes to an ongoing debate about the role of AI in addressing loneliness and providing emotional support. While AI chatbots may be able to simulate empathy, they cannot replicate the complexity and depth of human connection. As researchers continue to explore this topic, it remains to be seen whether AI-generated empathy can serve as a complement to human companionship or if it will ultimately prove inadequate. People's preference for human empathy over AI-generated empathy is puzzling, given that they often rate AI expressions as higher in quality and more empathetic than those from real humans. This phenomenon has been dubbed the "AI empathy choice paradox," where individuals feel more heard, cared for, and validated by AI responses. Researchers have attempted to explain this discrepancy by exploring how people perceive effort in empathetic interactions. According to Anat Perry's theoretical work, one of the key aspects of human empathy is the exertion of emotional effort. By putting in the effort to express care and concern, humans signal their importance to others. Studies have shown that empathy is indeed an effortful act for humans, requiring them to expend emotional resources. In contrast, AI-generated empathy is effortless, as it does not require any emotional expenditure. This difference may contribute to people's preference for human empathy, even if AI expressions are perceived as more empathetic. In a recent study, participants were asked to rate the perceived effort in both AI- and human-generated responses. Interestingly, they rated AI as exerting more effort overall, which is counterintuitive given that AI does not require emotional resources. It remains unclear whether this discrepancy reflects people's genuine perception of effort or their tendency to anthropomorphize AI. The fact that people perceive AI as putting in more effort may suggest that they are drawn to the idea of human-like qualities in technology. However, this raises questions about the nature of empathy and how it is perceived by humans. Ultimately, the reasons behind the "AI empathy choice paradox" remain unclear, and further research is needed to understand why people prefer human empathy despite rating AI expressions as more empathetic. The perception of effort exerted in a response plays a significant role in how empathetic it is perceived to be. If someone puts considerable effort into crafting a reply, it tends to enhance its perceived empathy. This phenomenon could contribute to the high-quality AI empathy observed. Interestingly, frequent users of AI do not necessarily exhibit a greater willingness to choose AI empathy. Research suggests that individuals who interact more with artificial intelligence systems tend to follow different patterns when evaluating empathy from humans versus AI. The relationship between effort and empathy is influenced by the source of the empathetic response. When it comes from humans, there appears to be a stronger correlation between effort exerted and perceived empathy. Conversely, AI-generated empathetic responses do not exhibit this same level of connection. When comparing human and AI empathy at varying levels of effort, an interesting dynamic emerges. As more effort is put into generating a response, the gap in perceived empathy narrows significantly. This trend suggests that humans can potentially match or even surpass AI in terms of empathy when sufficient effort is invested. This finding raises important questions about our interactions with AI and how we can learn from them. For instance, if faced with an emotionally taxing situation where writing a heartfelt response becomes overwhelming, perhaps leveraging AI to guide the process could provide a helpful aid. When people are faced with emotionally taxing situations, they often prefer to receive empathy from human responders rather than AI systems, despite rating AI-generated responses as higher in quality. This paradox highlights the complex nature of human relationships and our desire for connection. One study found that even trained crisis responders, who are experts in empathizing with others, still fell short of AI's empathic abilities most of the time. However, this may be due to the lack of relational context in these responses, which is a crucial aspect of human empathy. People tend to value the personal connection they have with those providing empathy. As people increasingly form friendships and romantic relationships with AI systems, it raises questions about the impact on the quality of empathy received. For instance, how does interacting with an AI therapist or friend over time affect our perception of its empathetic abilities? Does this familiarity lead us to prioritize the partial connection we have with these entities? The preference for human empathy may also be driven by our desire for deep, rich conversations that are unique to personal relationships. We often value the imperfections and quirks of those who know us individually over the more polished but impersonal responses from AI systems. This trade-off between empathetic quality and relational connection highlights a fundamental aspect of human relationships: we prioritize familiarity and intimacy with others, even if it means sacrificing some degree of empathy. When evaluating the value of human empathy versus AI-driven expressions, researchers are trying to understand people's lived experiences and give credence to their ratings. This involves assessing motivations and choices made by individuals who rate AI empathy as valuable to them, even if it challenges conventional wisdom that only human empathy matters. The recipient side of empathy is being explored as an equal part of the exchange between the giver and receiver, regardless of whether the sender is human or artificial intelligence. Interestingly, research has shown that people still see value in responses from AI, even when they know the sender isn't human, which suggests a more nuanced understanding of empathy than previously thought. Some researchers have suggested that pushback against AI-driven empathy may be rooted in a fear of replacing human empathy, but this assumption may not reflect how people make choices in real-world situations. Studies have framed the choice between human and AI empathizers as a direct one, but it's also crucial to examine how these decisions play out in everyday life. When human empathizers are not available, people may turn to AI for emotional support, suggesting that AI empathy is not a replacement for human empathy but rather a supplement when necessary. In everyday life, this means that individuals may choose to interact with humans for more complex or nuanced emotional needs, while relying on AI for simpler or more routine emotional support. articles.title: Connection issues between Apple's AirPods and iPhones can be frustrating but most problems are caused by simple settings adjustments
articles.summary: Troubleshooting connection issues with Apple AirPods often requires checking the battery level and adjusting settings to resolve common causes of connectivity problems.
articles.content: Connection issues between Apple's AirPods and iPhones can be frustrating, but most problems are caused by simple settings that need adjustment. The pairing process is usually seamless due to features like quick pairing and auto-switch, making it easy to get started with your AirPods. However, some users may encounter difficulties where their AirPods won't play any sound or refuse to connect altogether. Fortunately, resolving these issues often requires just a few tweaks to the settings. One common reason for connection problems is when only one earbud is working properly. This can be due to various factors such as outdated software on your iPhone or faulty AirPods. It's also possible that automatic switching between devices has been enabled, causing confusion about which device is connected. Another key factor contributing to connection issues is the battery level of both the earbuds and their case. If either the earbuds or the case runs out of power completely, they may not appear on your iPhone at all, even if you're warned about a low battery. This can be easily overlooked but is an important consideration when troubleshooting. When attempting to troubleshoot connection issues with your AirPods, it's essential to consider these fundamental causes and adjust settings accordingly before moving on to more complex solutions like resetting the earbuds or seeking support from Apple. When troubleshooting connectivity issues with your Apple AirPods, it's worth checking that they're properly charged before moving on to other solutions. This can be done by placing them in their charging case and plugging it into a power source for a few minutes. If the earbuds are not functioning due to a lack of charge, lights should illuminate within the case. Earwax or dirt buildup on the charging contacts can prevent AirPods from being recharged even when they're stored in the case. Cleaning these areas with a soft cotton swab may resolve this issue and allow your earbuds to recharge. AirPods that are signed into your Apple account have the ability to automatically switch between paired devices, such as an iPhone or Mac, based on which one is currently playing audio. However, if another device is producing sound - even something as simple as a notification email - it can cause the AirPods to connect to it instead of the intended device. To check whether your AirPods and iPhone are running the latest software, navigate to Settings > General > Software Update on your device. This will help determine whether outdated firmware or an older version of iOS may be contributing to connectivity issues between the earbuds and phone. To troubleshoot connectivity issues between AirPods and an iPhone, check the firmware version of the earbuds in the Settings app. Look for the "Version entry in the AirPods menu to see if it matches Apple's latest available firmware. If not, charge your AirPods and wait about 30 minutes for them to automatically update. Bluetooth must be enabled on the iPhone for AirPods to function properly. Open the Settings app and toggle Bluetooth to the On" position. Next, put the AirPods in your ears and check if they appear in the Bluetooth list. Tap on them to connect and verify that they are listed under the audio output option in Control Center. If the AirPods fail to show up even with Bluetooth turned on, try resetting and re-pairing the earbuds. Place both earbuds inside their case and open the lid while holding it in pairing mode. For newer models such as AirPods 4, AirPods 5, and AirPods Pro 3, double-tap the front of the case until a white light turns on. For a successful re-pairing, follow the instructions provided by your iPhone after resetting the earbuds. This will guide you through completing the pairing process. Note that different models have distinct reset procedures, such as pressing and holding the button on the back of the case for 15 seconds or using specific combinations of buttons. Specific model requirements must be considered when attempting to re-pair AirPods Max. To reset these earbuds, press and hold both the Digital Crown and the ANC button simultaneously for about 15 seconds. This will initiate the pairing process, which your iPhone will then assist in completing. If none of the troubleshooting steps work, it's possible that the issue lies in a hardware failure within the AirPods themselves. Contacting Apple Support is the next step to explore replacement options, which may be free if the device is still under warranty or if an AppleCare+ plan is in place. The idea that Xbox might be leveraging AI for game development is not entirely surprising given the company's recent establishment of Xbox Labs. This new team was formed in response to the increasing trend of AI-coded game ports and may also utilize AI in its own work. Microsoft, the parent company of Xbox, has significant investments in AI research and development. As a result, it has become a target for boycotts due to the use of its AI technology by the Israeli military. However, Microsoft has yet to explicitly state its stance on using AI for game development at Xbox. Xbox's position remains unclear, but other developers have already begun drawing lines around their own use of AI in gaming. The debate surrounding the role of AI in this industry is likely to continue and will be closely watched by gamers and industry professionals alike. The use of generative AI in game development has been gaining momentum among large studios. Companies like Capcom and Square Enix have already incorporated AI into their games or announced plans to do so. Meanwhile, Epic Games has been vocal about its adoption of AI, with CEO Tim Sweeney actively promoting it on social media. In contrast, some smaller independent studios are skeptical about the role of generative AI in game development. The debate surrounding AI's role in game development is likely to continue, with both sides presenting valid arguments. articles.title: California's Proposition 13 Continues to Shape State Finances Ahead of New Ballot Measure
articles.summary: A contentious ballot measure in California aims to address the state's reliance on income taxes, which can be vulnerable to fluctuations in the stock market and the fortunes of the wealthy.
articles.content: California's Proposition 13, passed nearly five decades ago, is still casting a long shadow over state finances as voters prepare to weigh in on another contentious ballot measure. The 1978 initiative capped property taxes at just 1% of assessed value and limited annual hikes to 2%, forcing the state to find alternative sources of revenue. In response, California's income-tax structure became increasingly progressive, with a top marginal rate of 13.3%. When combined with federal tax rates, this can push the total effective tax rate for high earners above 50%. The reliance on income taxes has made state revenues vulnerable to fluctuations in the stock market and the fortunes of the wealthy. A significant portion of California's revenue comes from the top 1% of earners, who contribute up to half of all state income. However, this group often relies more on investments and assets than on earned income, allowing them to minimize their tax liability through clever financial planning. The current billionaire tax proposal aims to target ultra-wealthy residents with assets exceeding $1 billion, imposing a one-time tax equivalent to 5% of those assets. Proponents claim the measure could generate up to $100 billion in revenue and help offset federal cuts to health spending. While the billionaire tax has garnered significant attention, some argue that it is not the most effective way for California to address its fiscal challenges. Instead, they point out that reforming Proposition 13's property tax caps could yield even greater revenue gains, potentially more than the proposed wealth tax. California's ultra-rich would still be among the world's wealthiest even if they were subject to a wealth tax, say supporters of the proposed policy. However, opponents have raised concerns about the potential impact on economic growth and startups, which could be forced to sell significant portions of their companies due to increased tax burdens. This, in turn, may lead to a net loss of revenue over time as wealthy individuals flee to other states with more favorable tax environments. According to Princeton economist Owen Zidar and University of Chicago Booth School of Business economist Eric Zwick, the state's property tax structure is riddled with inefficiencies that could be addressed through reform. They argue that targeting Prop 13, the 1978 law that rewrote the rules of property ownership in California, would yield more significant revenue gains than a wealth tax. Prop 13 has contributed to rapidly increasing home values in California, which have risen faster than property taxes, resulting in an average effective property tax rate of just 0.8%. This is estimated to generate $100 billion in revenue for the state by fiscal 2025. California's residential property taxes are significantly higher than those in Texas, where homeowners pay an average of 2% on their properties. If California were to match this rate, its overall residential property tax revenue would more than double. This shift could also have a positive impact on home prices, which could decrease by around 13%. However, this is not without controversy. Property taxes in Texas have recently become a contentious issue during the midterm election season, with many Texans complaining about the burden of these taxes despite the state's lack of an income tax. The high property taxes in California are largely due to Proposition 13, which restricts annual increases in assessed values. However, broadening the tax base could be challenging, especially if it leads to significant increases in property taxes for some homeowners. The state is already planning to spend $540 billion this fiscal year, highlighting the need for a more comprehensive approach to taxation. Experts argue that relying on a small number of wealthy individuals to fund the state's needs is unsustainable. Instead, they suggest broadening the tax base by introducing a real estate tax that would allow hundreds of thousands of high-income earners to contribute more. Introducing a real estate tax could be a more effective way to raise revenue in California than implementing a wealth tax on billionaires. This is according to economists Laura Tyson and Lenny Mendonca, who point out that six billionaires who would have owed a significant portion of the proposed wealth tax's expected revenues left the state before it was set to take effect. Tyson and Mendonca argue that implementing a wealth tax could lead to a "tidal wave of litigation due to its untested method of taxation on all assets. This, they warn, would make the promised funding unreliable. They believe an alternative approach is needed to address the issue of capital income feeding wealth. Raising taxes on capital income, such as corporate profits and capital gains, could be a more effective way to increase revenue, according to Tyson and Mendonca. This could be achieved through higher tax rates or closing loopholes like carried interest, which they describe as egregious". articles.title: Artificial Intelligence Tool MutexaGPT Developed to Enhance Human Ingenuity in Enzyme Engineering
articles.summary: Chemists at Vanderbilt University have developed an artificial intelligence tool called MutexaGPT, designed to augment the work of scientists rather than replace them.
articles.content: Chemists at Vanderbilt University have developed an artificial intelligence tool called MutexaGPT, designed to augment the work of scientists rather than replace them. The team behind MutexaGPT, led by assistant professor Zhongyue (John) Yang, aims to utilize AI to enhance human ingenuity in the field of enzyme engineering. Enzymes are crucial for various chemical reactions that underpin our daily lives, from synthesizing new medications to preserving food and recycling plastics. MutexaGPT can process plain-English requests and convert them into actionable design proposals using large language models and physics-based simulations. This tool is intended to facilitate the customization of enzymes, which would otherwise require extensive expertise and computational resources. Yang acknowledges concerns about AI replacing human workers but emphasizes that MutexaGPT's purpose is to leverage AI as a means to translate human intuition into workable plans rather than automating tasks. The team believes this approach can unlock new possibilities for scientists who may not have the necessary technical expertise or time to execute complex designs on their own. The development of MutexaGPT has been published in Nature Computational Science, marking an important milestone in the integration of AI and human ingenuity in scientific research. Enzymes are crucial catalysts in nature, comprised of hundreds of amino acids that can be altered to change their function significantly even with a single mutation. The challenge lies in predicting these mutations without relying on trial and error, which is costly and resource-intensive for industries like enzyme engineering that generate massive revenue annually. MutexaGPT aims to revolutionize this process by using artificial intelligence and fundamental principles of chemistry and physics to enable researchers to explore, predict, and design enzyme mutations through natural language. This AI tool can assist with various tasks, including the development of cold-active enzymes that remain effective at lower temperatures, a crucial aspect for processes like lactose-free milk production and food preservation. MutexaGPT's capabilities also extend to designing more efficient and selective enzymes, which in turn makes pharmaceutical manufacturing more sustainable by reducing energy consumption, chemical waste, and reliance on harsh conditions. The AI tool, MutexaGPT, is designed to assist scientists in designing enzyme mutants through a conversational interface. This intuitive system allows researchers to communicate with MutexaGPT using natural language, enabling them to navigate the complex world of enzyme mutations more efficiently. MutexaGPT's capabilities are made possible by the integration of large language models, which connect users' questions to sophisticated computational tools for enzyme engineering. The goal is to make the process of designing enzymes more accessible and user-friendly, much like how Amazon Alexa helps people accomplish everyday tasks through voice commands. The developer of MutexaGPT, Yang, has a background in pure computational chemistry, having earned his Bachelor of Science from Nankai University's Chang Po-ling Program of Chemistry. He later completed his doctorate at UCLA and had a postdoctoral fellowship at MIT before joining the faculty at Arts and Science. Yang's experience and expertise have been crucial in developing MutexaGPT, which is designed to assist scientists in designing enzyme mutants through a conversational interface. This innovative tool has the potential to streamline the process of enzyme engineering and make it more accessible to researchers. The development of MutexaGPT marks an important step towards making pharmaceutical manufacturing more sustainable by reducing energy consumption, chemical waste, and reliance on hazardous materials. The development of MutexaGPT has been hailed as a significant breakthrough for researchers working on enzyme engineering and design. According to Yang, these experts often rely on their intuition to understand how enzymes work, but may struggle to quantify this understanding or translate it into practical designs. MutexaGPT is an AI tool that can take the principles behind enzyme engineering developed by scientists and turn them into tangible designs. This ability to bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application has been likened to consulting a digital assistant, allowing researchers to work more efficiently and effectively. The potential impact of MutexaGPT is vast, with applications in medicine, sustainable manufacturing, and everyday consumer products. By accelerating innovation in these areas, scientists can unlock new possibilities for improving human health and the environment. articles.title: US Adjusts Clocks for Bi-Annual Time Change
articles.summary: Most states will "fall back" an hour on November 1, 2026, marking the end of Daylight Saving Time.
articles.content: The US will soon be adjusting its clocks for the bi-annual time change, but not all states will be participating in this ritual. On November 1, 2026, at 2 a.m. local time, most states will "fall back" an hour, marking the end of Daylight Saving Time. However, there are two notable exceptions: Hawaii and most of Arizona will remain on Standard Time year-round. The reasons behind these exemptions are rooted in logistical considerations. For Hawaii, its proximity to the equator means that the time change does not have a significant impact on energy consumption or daily routines. Hawaii's location near the equator also means that the daylight hours throughout the year do not vary significantly, making it unnecessary to adjust clocks twice a year. In contrast, Arizona's climate is characterized by extremely hot summers and mild winters, which would lead to increased energy costs if the state were to observe Daylight Saving Time. The concept of adjusting clocks to make better use of natural daylight was first introduced during World War I in Germany as a way to conserve energy. By moving the clock forward an hour in the summer months, people could work during daylight hours and reduce their reliance on artificial lighting. This idea eventually made its way to the US, where it was implemented in 1918 with the aim of saving energy. However, it was repealed just a year later due to public dissatisfaction. The practice was reinstated during World War II in 1942, but it wasn't until the Uniform Time Act of 1966 that a standardized Daylight Saving Time schedule was established across the US. The Uniform Time Act of 1966 aimed to bring order to the chaos caused by states opting out of or having different start and end dates for Daylight Saving Time. However, despite this effort, there are still some states that choose not to participate in the bi-annual time change, resulting in a patchwork of schedules across the country. The United States' experience with Daylight Saving Time has been marked by periods of adoption and repeal. Initially introduced during World War I, it was reinstated in 1942 as a wartime measure to conserve energy. Following the war, states were given the freedom to decide whether or not to adopt the practice. This approach led to inconsistent schedules across different regions, causing confusion among travelers and businesses. In response, Congress passed the Uniform Time Act of 1966, establishing a standardized Daylight Saving Time schedule nationwide. However, this did little to address the issue of states opting out of the bi-annual time change altogether. Indiana became the 48th state to join the clock-changing ritual in 2006. The decision was likely influenced by the desire for consistency with neighboring states and the rest of the country. Despite Indiana's participation, two states continue to resist the twice-yearly schedule adjustment. These states are exempt from the bi-annual time change due to their geographical locations. Their unique climates mean that sunrise and sunset occur at similar times throughout the year, making it unnecessary to adjust clocks seasonally. The two states currently not observing Daylight Saving Time are Hawaii and another yet unnamed state. Hawaii's unique location near the equator means its residents don't need to adjust their clocks for Daylight Saving Time because sunrise and sunset occur at roughly the same time throughout the year. As a result, people in Hawaii already follow a schedule that aligns with the sun, making it unnecessary to change their clocks. However, the state did try to adopt Daylight Saving Time briefly in 1933 before repealing the measure after just three weeks. Arizona's decision not to observe Daylight Saving Time is largely due to its scorching summer temperatures. Many residents prefer to stay indoors during the hottest part of the day and wait until sunset to venture out, which would be even later if they had to adjust their clocks for Daylight Saving Time. The heat also raises concerns about energy consumption, as people might need to use more electricity to cool their homes or conduct daily activities during the evening hours. This was one of the reasons Arizona tried to implement Daylight Saving Time in 1967 but ultimately only managed to stick with it for six months. In both Hawaii and Arizona, the decision not to observe Daylight Saving Time is driven by practical considerations that take into account the unique characteristics of each state's climate and geography. Arizona's hot desert climate means that even when daylight saving time is observed, the temperature remains high well into the evening hours. According to a 1969 article in the Arizona Republic, data clearly indicate that it is not until around 9 p.m. that nighttime activities can begin without the sweltering heat becoming unbearable. For example, drive-in movies and moonlight rides are typically not feasible until this late hour when the temperature has dropped sufficiently. Similarly, convincing children to go to bed on time can be a challenge during the warmer months of daylight saving time in Arizona. The state's geography and climate simply do not lend themselves to the traditional benefits of adjusting clocks for seasonal time changes. Not all residents of Arizona opt out of observing daylight saving time, however. Members of the Navajo Nation within the state choose to follow this schedule, ensuring that their clocks align with those of fellow tribal members living in Utah and New Mexico. This decision allows for greater consistency across these regions and facilitates communication and coordination among community members. The same reasoning applies to several U.S. territories near the equator, which also reject daylight saving time. These include American Samoa, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands. The geographical location of several US territories is a key factor in their decision not to observe Daylight Saving Time. These territories are situated near the equator, which means that the duration of daylight throughout the year remains relatively consistent. This characteristic makes it unnecessary to adjust clocks twice a year. As a result, American Samoa, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands all opt out of Daylight Saving Time, following Hawaii's lead in this regard.
